spec: Q6 of Evan's 2026-09-01 form (GA-9): 'log it as a ticket, do not chase now'. LOW PRIORITY - opened so it is on the record, NOT to be worked before T-6. T-5 found, on the way past, that GIMS's LIMS-System project has Glove.size declared type:float in noun_types.json while the stored rows contain 'lmao im a changling', '3 more boss', 'oh okay', 'ok I pull up' (spikes/T-5/probes/P3_number_fields_on_disk.txt). core/words/validation.py:88-97 is_number() rejects all four, so either some write path reaches store.put_record without validate_item_against_schema, or those rows predate the check. Read-only audit of INSERT/put_record paths in both trees; no fix in scope.
